name: RoboDojo RealEval
summary: 面向真机机器人任务的远程评测基准，提供任务配置、仿真环境和结果产物。
summaryEn: A real-robot evaluation benchmark with task configurations, simulation environments, and result artifacts.
scaleZh: 三种机器人形态下的 18 个真机任务
access: Official website and repository available; bulk real rollouts require verification
accessZh: 官方网页和仓库可用；完整真机回放仍待核验
verdict: 统一评测真机策略在不同任务和形态下表现的基准
verdictEn: A unified benchmark for real-robot policies across tasks and embodiments
wmNote: 任务状态和评测结果可用于比较闭环策略与世界模型交互能力。
wmNoteEn: Task states and evaluation artifacts support comparison of closed-loop policy and world-model interaction.
